meta.title: Phone2Laptop – Instant transfers between phone and computer
meta.description: Exchange files, photos, videos and text between your phone and computer with one scan. Free, fast and secure.

hero.title:
Transfer files
between your phone and computer
hero.intro:
Forget emailing yourself, WhatsApp messages and USB drives.
phone2laptop creates a temporary, secure link — automatically erased after 30 minutes.
hero.benefit2: 🖼️ 📄 Files, photos, videos, notes… everything syncs in real time
hero.benefit4: 🔒 Automatic deletion after 30 min — your data never lingers
hero.reassurance: Your session is erased automatically — even if you forget to delete everything.
hero.step1_title: Open this page on your computer
hero.step1_text: A secure QR code appears instantly.
hero.step3_text: Drop a file or type a note… it appears live on the other screen.

why.title: Why does phone2laptop exist?
why.lead: Because transferring a file from your phone to your computer should not be a chore.
why.p1: WhatsApp Web takes 10 to 30 seconds to load… just to send yourself a photo.
why.p2: Email: attachment limits, spam and wasted time.
why.p3: Cloud (Google Drive, iCloud…): account required, slow syncing, limited storage.
why.p4: USB cable: where is it? And what if your Mac adapter is missing?
why.result: The result: wasted time, frustration and forgotten files.
why.s2: 100% free, with no account, ads or limits.
why.s3: No personal data is collected, stored or analyzed.
why.s4: End-to-end encryption: the key stays on your devices, so we cannot access your files or notes.
why.s5: Automatic deletion after 30 minutes — your files disappear on their own.
why.s6: Open source: full transparency and verifiable security.

reasons.title: Why thousands of users love it
reasons.r1t: No need to find a cable, open Gmail or sign into Dropbox.
reasons.r2t: Your files are end-to-end encrypted and everything disappears after 30 min.
reasons.r3t: Chrome, Safari, Firefox… On Windows, Mac, Android and iOS. No app to download.
reasons.r4t: No pro version or hidden limit. Just a simple, honest and useful tool.
